purpose: Keep five distinct spatial quantities visually and verbally separate before the empirical benchmark figures are interpreted.

panels.title: Pointwise environmental support
panels.question: How locally supported is each location?
panels.role: A frozen support field supplies a local value for each location; it does not by itself identify occurrence-anchored configuration.

panels.title: Spatial block cross-validation
panels.question: How strictly is prediction evaluated?
panels.role: Spatial blocks separate training and held-out records to reduce geographic leakage; they change evaluation, not the structural estimand.

panels.title: Direct source distance
panels.question: How far is a target from a training occurrence?
panels.role: Nearest-source distance is a direct proximity covariate. Equal distance does not imply equal intermediate configuration.

panels.title: Matrix-aware current flow
panels.question: How does the landscape conduct between focal locations?
panels.role: Current flow uses a declared resistance surface to summarize multi-path landscape connectivity and is a strong structural competitor when such data are available.

panels.title: Occurrence-anchored EOG
panels.question: Does target-to-anchor configuration persist across declared graph assumptions?
panels.role: Connected frequency is the share of predeclared graph scenarios in which a target is connected to training-presence anchors. It is an assumption-robust structural diagnostic.
